name: Seal of Fury
tooltip:
Seal of Fury
Level 60
120 Mana
Instant
Requires Paladin
Requires level 34
Fills the Paladin with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 19 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 87 to 94 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 3 sec.
